items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 18 at 2:58AM PST until November 18 at 3:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
6 to 11 ft expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 18 at 3:25AM PST until November 19 at 4:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, An increased risk for
sneaker waves and strong rip currents with breaking waves of
13 to 17 ft. For the High Surf Advisory, Large breaking waves
of 15 to 18 ft.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through this afternoon.
For the High Surf Advisory, from 4 PM today to 4 PM PST
Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning,
pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 18 at 3:18AM PST until November 18 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...East Bay Interior Valleys.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
